body:
Private equity news across North America: buyouts, fundraising, exits and investor activity in the region.

Investors expect GPs to generate outperformance through capabilities they cannot easily replicate in-house, according to panelists at PEI Group’s SIPA Day.

The firm updated its full-year fundraising guidance for the year from $50bn to $55bn after moving forward several fund closes initially budgeted for 2027.

Park Road succeeded in topping the fund’s original target and its adjusted target, which resulted from 'fervid interest' among LPs in the firm's strategy, sources told PEI Private Equity.

GP Stakes VI has gathered about $11bn to date, including co-investment, CFO Alan Kirshenbaum said on the firm's Q3 earnings call Thursday.

Mega-funds that held final closes in Q1-Q3 2026 gathered $169.5bn between them, taking 24% of all capital raised, PEI Group data shows.

Kohlberg Investors XI’s final close is expected to occur in the first half of 2027, according to pension documents.

GPE XI is the third-largest private equity fund on record, PEI Group data shows.

The London-headquartered firm has a $12bn fundraising target for Apax XII.

Why opening the door for 'retail' is only half the fundraising battle, and a mid-market stalwart returns with its flagship.

The firm joins Advent International and TPG, among other managers, nearing final closes on their latest flagship funds.
